24.why: Passes split B/D. Graphite is pure carbon and silicon is an element too: both right. (Alumina and brass are a compound and an alloy.)
24.reasoning: An element is made of only one kind of atom. Silicon is an element, and so is graphite, which is a form of pure carbon. Alumina is a compound (aluminium oxide) and brass is a mixture of copper and zinc.
24.notice: Two options are correct: silicon is an element, and so is graphite (a form of pure carbon). In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
